vibe_and_emotion: Underground hacker, high-stakes crypto trading, professional yet extremely technical. A true command-center feeling with dense data, no fluff, zero distraction. It should look like a bespoke trading terminal built for degens.

typography.font_strategy: The 'Retro-Futurism / Terminal' Look. Everything is monospace to enforce the 'coding/terminal' aesthetic. High legibility for dense numbers.

rules: Never use pure black or white. Background is tinted with deep indigo.
Primary accent (#00FF66) should be used extremely sparingly (active bots, positive P&L, key CTA).
Borders are critical: Use 1px sharp borders everywhere to define containers instead of shadows.

layout_spacing.strategy: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
layout_spacing.gap_strategy: Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-1px for grid borders).

surfaces.dashboards: Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle border, no shadow. The 'Grid Borders' look.
surfaces.headers: Solid background with a hard bottom border. No glassmorphism here, pure terminal tech.
surfaces.modals: Flat black background, sharp neon green 1px border for focus.

component_instructions.general: Heavily customize Shadcn components to remove rounding (`rounded-none`). Use sharp edges.
component_instructions.buttons: Flat, 1px border. Hover state should invert colors or slide a solid block of color.
component_instructions.tables: Dense. Use `border-collapse`. Hide alternating row colors; instead rely on high-contrast text and hover states (`hover:bg-[#13131A]`).
component_instructions.charts: Use Recharts. Ensure chart tooltip has black background with sharp 1px border. Chart lines must be 1.5px thick, strictly using primary/danger colors.
component_instructions.forms: Inputs should have transparent backgrounds, 1px bottom border (or full sharp border), and glow green on focus (`focus:ring-0 focus:border-[#00FF66]`).
component_instructions.data_testid_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

motion_interactions.hover_states: Slight brightness increase. For borders, change from `#1A1A24` to `#303040`.
motion_interactions.transitions: Instant or very fast (`duration-100`). No bouncy or elastic easing. Linear or sharp ease-out.
motion_interactions.loaders: ASCII art loaders or simple monospace text pulsing 'LOADING_...'.

icons.usage: Use Phosphor icons in 'regular' or 'duotone' weight for dense developer tools.

libraries.motion: framer-motion (use strictly for layout transitions, keep it minimal)
libraries.scrolling: lenis (MANDATORY for momentum scrolling on landing page)

image_urls.description: Dogecoin macro shot, use for coin detail headers or trending list icons.
Ethereum silver coin close-up, use for chain selection or ETH base pairs.
Solana logo element, use for SOL network selection or pairs.

media.rules: Never use placeholder images. If specific chain logos are missing, use typographic logos or geometric abstract shapes from the text itself (e.g. [ ETH ] / [ SOL ]).

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this JSON and implement EXACTLY as specified.
Do not use generic SaaS blue colors. Stick to the void black, neon green, amber, and electric pink palette.
Use Phosphor icons. Do not rely on lucide-react if Phosphor fits the terminal vibe better.
All components must be `rounded-none`. NO SOFT CORNERS.
For the trading chart, use Recharts and make it look like a TradingView dark theme setup.
Implement the 'Control Room' grid layout for the bot dashboard. Every pixel utilized, tall narrow lists, main chart taking center stage.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all functional elements (e.g., `data-testid="buy-meme-button"`).
For empty states or loaders, use monospace text like 'AWAITING_SIGNAL...' instead of generic spinners.
